g.text: Known completion-direction harm by registered comparison
Known completion-direction harm (bag cases within each parent)
Known harm = later completion when both finished + reference-only completion. Both-unfinished cases remain censored, never equal.
Four parents share one historical template; bag IDs repeat across panels. These are not four independent days or distinct populations.
